context: Two elders reminisce about a favorite old restaurant
purpose: Teach: お薦め/デパート/倶楽部/焼酎/ハム/手軽/ゆったり/きちっと

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: あの駅前のデパートの上階にあった洋食屋、覚えてるかい？
lines.en: Do you remember that Western-style restaurant on the top floor of the department store by the station?
lines.style: Nostalgic opening, gentle elder male tone reminiscing fondly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: もちろんよ。マスターが必ずきちっと蝶ネクタイをして迎えてくれてね。
lines.en: Of course. The master would always greet us properly with his bow tie on.
lines.style: Warm grandmother voice, soft chuckle of fond recollection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お薦め料理は決まって特製のハムステーキだったな。
lines.en: The recommended dish was always their special ham steak, wasn't it.
lines.style: Slow, savoring delivery as if tasting the memory again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あなた、いつも焼酎の水割りを一杯だけ頼んでらしたわね。
lines.en: You always used to order just one shochu with water, didn't you.
lines.style: Teasing affectionate grandmother tone, light laughter behind voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 二階の社交倶楽部のじいさん連中もよく降りてきて賑やかだった。
lines.en: The old fellows from the social club upstairs would come down and liven the place up.
lines.style: Warm reminiscent baritone, faint smile in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: そうそう、奥の席でゆったりお喋りできるのが何より良かったわ。
lines.en: Yes yes, being able to chat leisurely at the back table was the best part.
lines.style: Soft elderly woman, drawn-out vowels carrying genuine longing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 値段も手軽でね、年金暮らしには本当に有難い店だった。
lines.en: The prices were reasonable too — a truly precious place for us pensioners.
lines.style: Sincere wistful elder, quiet gratitude in lower register.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 今度また、あの辺りを二人でゆっくり歩いてみましょうよ。
lines.en: Let's walk through that neighborhood together slowly again sometime soon.
lines.style: Tender closing invitation, warm and inviting elderly tone.
